note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
2.3 Celebrity culture
Key focus
- famous people, media influence, role models, fame and achievements.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Support opinions with evidence; use relative clauses and comparatives without confusing who/what is being discussed.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Il mio cantante preferito scrive le sue canzoni e suona anche il pianoforte. L’atleta ha vinto la gara nonostante un infortunio. Molti giovani imitano lo stile dei famosi che vedono sui social. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: My favourite singer writes his own songs and also plays the piano. The athlete won the race despite an injury. Many young people copy the style of famous people they see on social media. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
